collections.title: Emissions estimates
collections.dek: Ready-to-use tables for analysis and comparison.

downloads.title: Annual emissions
downloads.dek: By sector, source category and greenhouse gas, with the evidence grade on every row.

downloads.title: Provincial emissions
downloads.dek: Annual estimates for each province. Emissions are not measured provincially, so these are allocations — but the road-fuel split rides OCAC's own provincial sales, not a proxy.

downloads.title: District emissions
downloads.dek: Annual estimates by district, with the allocation status and boundary each rests on.

downloads.title: Monthly emissions
downloads.dek: Every month of the record, saying for each whether the timing is observed, modelled or evenly spread.

collections.title: The activity behind the estimates
collections.dek: The fuel, agriculture and household data the emissions are calculated from — usable on their own, without the emissions.

downloads.title: Petroleum sales by fuel and customer group
downloads.dek: Petrol, diesel, furnace oil, kerosene and aviation fuel as OCAC publishes them, by customer class. Sales into a class, not fuel burned in it.

downloads.title: Petroleum sales by area
downloads.dek: The same publication's monthly area pages, province by province. Fuel sold in a province is not fuel burned there — freight crosses boundaries.

downloads.title: Livestock populations
downloads.dek: Census counts by animal type, province and district, with the Economic Survey's forward estimate labelled a projection and never summed with them.

downloads.title: Crop area & production
downloads.dek: Area and production by crop, year and district. A district figure split from a pooled parent is marked an allocation, not an observation.

downloads.title: Fertiliser offtake
downloads.dek: Monthly product offtake and nutrient totals. Offtake is distribution, not application to fields, and tonnes of product are never tonnes of nitrogen.

downloads.title: Power plant fuel & generation
downloads.dek: Plant-level fuel quantity and net generation from the regulator's own tables, with the implied heat rate marked as derived.

downloads.title: Monthly plant generation
downloads.dek: Electricity generated, plant by plant, month by month. Generation only — the fuel behind it was never measured monthly.

downloads.title: Household fuel use
downloads.dek: Design-weighted survey aggregates by province and urban/rural, with quantities, expenditure and the sample behind each.

downloads.title: Industrial fuel use
downloads.dek: Coal and gas by published customer group, and the gas a fertiliser plant turns into ammonia kept apart from the gas it burns.
downloads.coverage: Ten fiscal years · HDIP · OGRA · NFDC

downloads.title: Industrial production
downloads.dek: Clinker and cement as each company reported it, with national output controls and clinker trade. Company figures are never split across plants.

downloads.title: Gas and oil production
downloads.dek: National and provincial output, and the gas each field supplies to each utility system.

downloads.title: Gas network and unaccounted-for gas
downloads.dek: Utility sales, pipeline lengths and customer counts. Unaccounted-for gas is here too — and it is not a leakage measurement.

downloads.title: Waste services and sanitation
downloads.dek: How households say their waste is collected, and JMP's sanitation shares. Reported services, not measured tonnage.

downloads.title: Waste flows (modelled)
downloads.dek: Generation, collection, open burning and the unresolved remainder. An estimate from a per-capita rate and a fate partition — not measured municipal tonnage.

downloads.title: Railway fuel and traffic
downloads.dek: Pakistan Railways' own metered diesel and furnace oil, with train-, passenger- and tonne-kilometres beside it.

downloads.title: Airport movements and passengers
downloads.dek: Aircraft movements, passengers, cargo and mail by airport across eighteen fiscal years, and the same year cut by airline.

downloads.title: Source details for the activity tables
downloads.dek: The twenty technical fields behind every activity row — source file, row, column, transformation and combinability — joined to the tables above on Record ID.

downloads.title: Column guide for the activity tables
downloads.dek: What every column of every activity table means, one line per column.

downloads.title: Registered vehicles by district
downloads.dek: Cumulative registered stock as at 30 June, by district and class. Not observed traffic, and not an active fleet.

collections.title: Air pollutants
collections.dek: Emissions from the sources this release covers. Emitted mass, not ambient concentrations.

downloads.title: Annual estimates
downloads.dek: Seven pollutants by sector and year, each in its own mass unit and never converted to CO₂-equivalent.

downloads.title: Provincial estimates
downloads.dek: The same seven pollutants allocated to each province, for every year of the record.

downloads.title: District estimates
downloads.dek: The same allocation carried down to districts, with the status each district's share rests on.

downloads.title: Air pollutants by source class
downloads.dek: Boilers, furnaces, engines, kilns and captive generators; ammonia, steel and soda ash processes; oil and gas segments, refineries and flares — each with its factor rows, activity and uncertainty, and the typed absences beside them.

downloads.title: Lahore District by sector
downloads.dek: The district's share of each sector's allocation, year by year, beside the national mass no geometry could place below a province.

downloads.title: Coverage & screening
downloads.dek: What is covered, what is not, and the screening scenarios — which are kept apart from the estimates.

collections.title: Methods & uncertainty
collections.dek: The choices behind each estimate, and how certain it is.

downloads.title: Emission factors
downloads.dek: Every factor the inventory applies, with its value, unit, applicability and the publication it comes from.

downloads.title: Conversion parameters
downloads.dek: The calorific values, densities and conversion assumptions the calculations rest on, each marked default or country-specific.

downloads.title: Uncertainty intervals
downloads.dek: The interval around each year's total, and around the change from one year to the next.

downloads.title: Uncertainty by category
downloads.dek: Where the uncertainty comes from: by source category and by the resolution the estimate was made at.

downloads.title: Alternative assumptions
downloads.dek: The named alternatives whose effects are ranges rather than probabilities, and what each one changes.

downloads.title: Coverage & missing estimates
downloads.dek: What is estimated, not estimated, counted elsewhere or out of scope — and, where something is missing, whether the data exists at all.

downloads.title: Mass behind the gaps
downloads.dek: How much is likely to sit in each gap, given as a bracket rather than a single figure.

downloads.title: Source register
downloads.dek: Every publication the inventory reads, with its publisher, edition and how to obtain a copy.

downloads.title: Source streams
downloads.dek: Each series the inventory draws on, traced to the document and table the numbers were read from.

downloads.title: Data dictionary
downloads.dek: What every stream is and which sector it feeds, in the vocabulary the tables themselves use.

collections.title: Maps & grids
collections.dek: Spatial data for GIS and modelling.

downloads.title: Annual emissions grid
downloads.dek: Native greenhouse-gas cell masses, one file per structural configuration.

downloads.title: Monthly grid
downloads.dek: The reference year month by month, on the same grid.

downloads.title: Monthly grid, all diverted dung burned
downloads.dek: The same twelve months rebuilt with all the dung agriculture diverts burned in households (configuration L), for comparison with the reference above.

downloads.title: Air pollutant grid
downloads.dek: Seven covered-source pollutants, with separate annual and monthly files for each configuration; species and configurations must not be added.

downloads.title: EDGAR-aligned grid
downloads.dek: The same emissions on EDGAR's 0.1° lattice, so the two can be compared cell for cell.
